title: HOCA-Bench: Beyond Semantic Perception to Predictive World Modeling via Hegelian Ontological-Causal Anomalies
reasoning: The paper uses Hegelian philosophical concepts (ontology and causality) as a framework to categorize physical anomalies in videos. While it touches on philosophical logic (epistemology), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, ethics, or morals; rather, it focuses on the physical reasoning capabilities of Video Large Language Models.
